title: Earful failure bundle manifest
description: manifest.json of an earful.bundle/1 directory: what failed, on what, and how the case was reduced. Beside it, under fixed names, are original.case.json and minimal.case.json (earful.case/1) and the normalized ledger of running each.

predicate.description: The failure, frozen: the contract and the rule of it that broke.

framework.description: The framework release the failure was found on.

clock.description: The clock the reduced case ran on.

formats.description: The versions of the formats the bundle is written in.

environment.description: What the bundle was made with, by name: interpreter, platform, libraries. For the record; a replay does not depend on it.

scenario_digest.description: SHA-256 of the source text of the module that defines the scenario function the cases name. It covers that one file and no module it imports. Empty if the source could not be read. A replay compares it to tell whether that file has changed.

original.description: The case as it was found.

runs.description: How many times the system was run to reduce the case.

steps.description: What the reduction did, in order.

complete.description: False: the run budget was spent before nothing more could be reduced.

differences.description: Every way the reduced case differs from the scenario as its author wrote it. Empty: the author's scenario fails as written, or no author's scenario was given.

windows.description: For each time the reduction settled, how far it can move while the reduced case still breaks the rule.

variable.description: The time, as the reduced case names it: its kind and its index.

lo_us.description: The least value at which it still breaks.

lo_end.description: Why the search downwards stopped. passes: a run just beyond does not break the rule. blocked: no case exists beyond, or none could be judged. reach: the search gave up.

resolution_us.description: How finely each end was located.

instant.description: It breaks at one value and not a microsecond either side.

lo_unjudged.description: Present where lo_end is blocked by a run that could not be judged: why, as the search says it.

repeats.description: How many times the reduced case was run when the bundle was made.

distinct_hashes.description: How many different ledgers those runs gave. A bundle is written only if it is 1.

schema_minor.description: Additive format revision within major version 1. Absent means 0. Unknown optional fields are ignored by readers. 1 added case_digest.

hash.description: The ledger hash of running the case.

case_digest.description: SHA-256 of the case file's contents as one line of JSON, keys sorted and no spaces. A reader refuses a case file that differs. Since schema_minor 1; absent from a bundle written before it, whose case files cannot be verified.

speeches.description: How many user speeches the case has.

delays.description: How many provider delays it declares.

findings.description: What the checker said about the rule in that run, in its own words. Side by side, the two show whether the reduction kept the same failure.
